br.br:
1. An endoscopic instrument comprising:
an instrument body that comprises at least one flexible section that can be wound in at least one winding; and
a holding device that comprises a gripper for holding the at least one winding that is rotatably supported on the instrument body, wherein the gripper has a tube-shaped center part from which a latch extends away with radial distance to the center part around at least a part of the circumference of the center part.
2. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the in- strument body consists of a supply section and a probe section.
3. The endoscopic instrument of claim 2, wherein the probe section is flexible and can be wound in at least one, preferably multiple windings.
4. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the grip- per is a one-piece rigid plastic part.
5. The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the grip- per is arranged on a base and rotatably supported.
6. The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the grip- per comprises a holding space for the probe section, wherein the holding space is curved around the instru- ment body.
7. The endoscopic instrument of claim 6, wherein the hold- ing space is longer than one third rotation of the grip- per in rotation direction of the gripper.
8. The endoscopic instrument of claim 4, wherein the grip- per comprises at least one latch recess for holding a section of the instrument body.
9. The endoscopic instrument of claim 5, wherein the base comprises at least one latch recess for holding a sec- tion of the instrument body.
10. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the hold- ing device is secured on the instrument body in a non- displaceable manner.
11. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the hold- ing device is undetachably held on the instrument body.
12. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the hold- ing device comprises a base configured for attachment to an instrument having a non-round cross-section.
13. The endoscopic instrument of claim 12, wherein the base surrounds the supply section or the probe section around the whole circumference or alternatively, only around a part of its circumference.
14. The endoscopic instrument of claim 1, wherein the hold- ing device is axially movably arranged on the supply section or the probe section.
15. A holding device for an endoscopic instrument, the endo- scopic instrument comprising an instrument body having at least one flexible section configured to be wound in at least one winding, wherein the holding device comprises a gripper for hold- ing the at least one winding, wherein the gripper can be rotatably arranged on the in- strument body, and
wherein the gripper comprises a tube-shaped center part from which a latch extends away in radial distance to the center part around at least a part of the circumfer- ence of the center part. - 15 - - 16 - - 17 - 200380.00286/126997494v.1 200380.00286/126997494v.1
